summary: Replay Lab is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that replays a completed session turn with selected candidates and compares request-surface evidence, trajectory, and execution metrics to support regression debugging.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily an agent testing/debugging utility: it freezes a completed DSH turn as baseline, runs a single approved candidate session, and compares baseline/candidate results via an explicit scorecard of request-surface evidence and execution metrics. Evidence in the readme and manifest shows web UI integration, replay control flow, and isolated workspace execution, so it is best classified as a testing/debugging workbench rather than a general-purpose tooling or communication plugin.
